displayIdentity.body: Advance preparation protects the promised gift. It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you about the service to the saints, I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.
displayIdentity.title: Advance preparation protects the promised gift
